C1125.title: AI Escalates Cyberattack Risks: Deepfakes and Precision Phishing Threats Intensify
C1125.summary: Experts from Fudan University stated at the 2026 Yangpu Digital Salon that AI has become a key factor accelerating attacks, intensifying social engineering threats like deepfakes and precision phishing, driving malware proliferation and mutation, and significantly lowering the technical and resource barriers to launching attacks.

references.title: When AI Becomes Both 'Spear' and 'Shield': Experts Discuss Platform Security Breakthroughs Amid Automated Attacks
